item.title: Ask HN: Calorie Trackers
item.summary: Hi HN. Trying to get into calorie tracking. Only tried MyFitnessPal. Looking to strike a balance between being concious about what I eat and tracking with a reasonable degree of accuracy and flexibility (e.g. eating out). Interested in hearing what other people’s experiences with calorie tracking have been like and lessons Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49362413 Points: 2 # Comments: 2
